answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lotus of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, no identity may audit its own recruit. Every claim climbs the plume of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the river re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
